title: centaurea xanthocephala
intro: Centaurea xanthocephala, commonly known as Yellow-flowered Knapweed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea xanthocephala are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and potential uses, but its bioactive constituents have been identified as the primary drivers of its therapeutic actions.
